title: Live queue readiness retry: race guard, announcements and one state source (RF-163 review follow-ups)
acceptance: A card's readiness Retry cannot be overwritten by an older fetch: fetchOne shares the candidate effect's generation guard (or a per-class token), so a candidate change during a retry, or a class removed and re-added, never leaves a stale error or an orphan result.
Screen-reader users hear a retry start and finish: the queue status or the card announces "Checking readiness…" and the outcome, not only aria-busy.

The retrying flag lives in LivePayloadState (for example a refreshing error variant) rather than a separate set the card and the ranking read differently, and fetchOne reuses the effect's fetch-and-map helper.

A card whose retry lands runnable is re-ranked deliberately: either it may take the copper at once (documented), or the queue holds its order until the instructor acts, and the ranking comment says which.
The busy "Checking…" copper button looks busy (not just cursor-progress), so it does not read as an enabled action that does nothing.

evidence.summary: Non-blocking findings from the two RF-163 pre-PR reviews, not fixed in that PR (a candidate change during a retry still resets the card to loading; see item 1).
Owner, 2026-11-06 in the Neo session: "Approve with defaults" for RF-200, RF-199 and RF-201; RF-201 item 4 default: the queue holds its order until the instructor acts.
RF-201 fix; draft PR is the claim.

Live queue readiness Retry races (RF-201): an overtaken Retry result is dropped; a class removed during its Retry is read again when added back. The RF-163 queue test now also checks the start and outcome announcements, the busy styling, and that order and copper hold after the Retry lands runnable. All failed on the code before (the held order checked separately by ranking on the latest result: Beta moved ahead of Alpha).

Deployed to production on 2026-11-07 from the Air: main f55b449a (#728, #744, #746, #745; records #743, #747), Worker 1d95a679-c9c3-4eb4-8371-980147c53a37, SPA assets/index-BVZTM4Zz.js, rollback ce487041-27d5-4edf-90e2-a6676522574e (75f09a1). No migrations. Smoke, headers and a 5-minute tail (0 exceptions) passed. Owner approval recorded before the deploy: https://github.com/steven-crosby/ritmofit-web/pull/746#issuecomment-6710041751. #746 for RF-201 is in that build. CI uses mock providers; this proves the deploy, not device behaviour.

resolution: All five items met on #746 (Neo, 2026-11-06). (1) Every run-payload read of a queue class, from the candidate effect or a Retry, takes that class’s next token; only its newest read may land, and only while the class is still in the queue. A Retry overtaken by a candidate change is dropped, and a class removed during its Retry leaves no orphan result to show when it is added back. (2) A hidden status line announces “Checking readiness for <class>…” when a Retry starts and its outcome when it lands (can run live / checked: not ready to run yet / still couldn’t check). (3) The retry flag is LivePayloadState’s error variant with refreshing: true; the separate retrying set is gone, and the effect and the Retry share one read helper (readLivePayload). (4) Owner default (2026-11-06): the queue holds its order until the instructor acts. A retried card ranks by the result it had before its Retry, so it keeps its place and the copper does not move; a candidate change or a new ordering ranks from the latest results. The ranking comment says so. (5) The busy Checking… button is dimmed (opacity-60) with a spinning mark (motion-safe), besides cursor-progress and aria-disabled.
